display.title: Capstone: The End Compass
display.subtitle: Forged from the Aether
description: The Eye of Ender will not serve you here. To even target the End portal,
you must first work Tier 4's first dimension, the Aether (Deep Aether's
biomes included), and forge an End Compass from its materials.
Reach the Aether below to begin. The End Compass points the way to an
End Bastion, the gateway structure that anchors the stronghold search,
so the End really does come after the Aether.
§7The End Compass item, its Aether recipe, and the End Bastion
§7structure are still being built (progression-framework 5). For now
§7this capstone tracks reaching the Aether, the prerequisite.
